lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (hint, new flow, redesign) and home notifications, as each has only a single test.
Finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen) proved helpful, with both tests showing positive noise-corrected gains (+1.0% and +2.0%) and one winning test.
Path layout changes (choose_path, layout) can be helpful, producing one clear winner (+5.5% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) yielded one winning test (+3.3% after noise correction), though a second test showed no clear effect.
Initial predictions in Round 1 were overly optimistic, but underpredicted winning tests in Round 2 (path layout) and Round 3 (finish new screen).

candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet adoption selection so users build an affinity with their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Early sign-in causes high drop-off (76.9% step conversion) and users lack context on why account creation is needed until after adopting.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in now to safely sync your newly adopted companion to your cloud account.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption selection is explicitly permitted by Rule 4 and retains all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in reduces early friction, but structural flow changes require full release.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two-Column Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a two-column grid with live pet previews and trait badges.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long median decision time (89s), indicating choice paralysis.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a buddy to live and play on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen retains the pet picking functionality while updating layout and components.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%) and long time; redesign is promising but costly.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Cheat Sheet Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated cheat sheet screen at the end of onboarding explaining hotkeys, dragging, and hiding desktop controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

new_controls_cheatsheet.headline: Essential Desktop Pet Controls
new_controls_cheatsheet.body: Learn how to interact with, move, or hide your desktop pet anytime.

components.text: Right-click pet for Quick Menu & Hide option
Click and drag to reposition anywhere on screen

guard.reason: Adding a new controls cheat sheet screen after the home intro overlay is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish new screens consistently perform well in past tests (+1.6% avg), addressing reported tickets.

candidates.title: Guided Photo Upload Best Practices Flow
candidates.change: Insert a photo guidelines step before custom photo upload to demonstrate clear lighting and pose requirements.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failures or wrong looks, contributing to adoption step friction.

new_photo_guide.headline: Photo Upload Best Practices
new_photo_guide.body: Use well-lit, front-facing photos for optimal pet generation quality.

upload_photos.hint: Clear front-facing photos yield the best pet rendering results.

guard.reason: Adding a new photo guideline step within the onboarding sub-flow is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding flow steps to adoption step lost conversion (-4.4%) in previous test.

candidates.title: Account Cloud Restore Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in restores existing pets automatically.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account automatically restores all saved pets and cloud progress.

guard.reason: Adding a clear hint on the sign-in screen does not break any base rules or dark pattern guidelines.

candidates.score_note: 8 support emails pinpoint sign-in account restore confusion; hints showed past wins.

candidates.title: Generation Stage Progress Checklist
candidates.change: Show a clear progress checklist and estimated timer while pet graphics and desktop hooks are generating.
candidates.why: Home wait step has a mean duration of 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear or app stalling.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop
waiting.body: Generating pet animations and setting up desktop hooks...

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen information and progress checklist is explicitly allowed by Rule 4 and retains the pet generation job.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info showed minimal effect (+0.7%) in past tests despite long mean wait times.

candidates.title: Spotlight Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Reframe path selection into a spotlight layout placing focus clearly on ready-made vs custom adoption.
candidates.why: 19.4% of users drop off at path selection; previous path layout changes provided significant positive gains (+5.5%).

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Adopt?
choose_path.body: Choose a ready-to-go companion or build a custom pet from your photo.

guard.reason: Redesigning the path selection layout preserves both ready-made adoption and custom pet creation options.

candidates.score_note: Path selection layout changes produced the strongest historical winner (+5.5%).

candidates.title: Desktop Ready System Notification Switch
candidates.change: Enable desktop system tray notifications when pet startup finishes and the pet is visible.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion over pets not appearing on screen after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at your desktop corner or system tray to start interacting with your pet.

guard.reason: Enabling ready notifications on home intro is an allowed modification under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Low cost config change; notifications have positive but limited test evidence.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Reassurance Copy
candidates.change: Update certificate screen headline and body text to emphasize permanent account cloud registration.
candidates.why: Deepens emotional connection during adoption and reduces user anxiety around pet data loss.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new companion is officially registered and securely saved to your account.

guard.reason: Updating certificate text preserves the official adoption certificate purpose without violating copy rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy update on the highest drop-off step to relieve user anxiety.

candidates.title: Path Choice Flexibility Hint
candidates.change: Add a reassuring hint explaining that users can create or switch pets anytime later in settings.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on path selection is high (514s), indicating hesitation and fear of making an irreversible choice.

choose_path.hint: You can always adopt additional pets or try custom creation later from settings.

guard.reason: Adding a path flexibility hint provides clear guidance without violating pricing or dark-pattern rules.

candidates.score_note: High mean hesitation time (514s) on path choice targeted with simple text hint.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, adoption new flow, choose path hint, and home notifications, as each has only 1 test.
Path layout changes (choose_path, layout) can be helpful, producing 1 winning test (+5.5% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen) can be helpful, yielding 1 winning test (+2.0% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) can be helpful, with 1 winning test (+3.3% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) and adoption redesign changes (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Initial predictions in Round 1 were overly optimistic, but underpredicted winning tests in Round 2 (path layout) and Round 3 (finish new screen).
